newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan govt, NTT have not yet agreed break up - NTT.
newsitem.headline: Japan govt, NTT have not yet agreed break up - NTT.

text.p: The Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications and Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) have not yet agreed to break up the firm, an NTT spokesman said on Monday.
"Although an agreement is expected to be reached this month, it is too early to say this is one," the spokesman said.
A spokesman for the Posts and Telecommunications Ministry was not immediately available for comment.

A Japanese business daily, Nihon Keizai Shimbun, reported on Monday that the ministry and NTT had reached an agreement to break up the firm by establishing a holding company as early as the 1998/99 business year.

The paper reported that NTT, Japan's largest telecommunications carrier, would be divided into three entities, comprising a company for long distance and international calls and two regional telephone companies.
